about.title: About
about.bio: I'm an Electronics and Semiconductor Engineering student at Tecnológico de Monterrey. I design, build and fly rocket flight computers, from multilayer PCB design to lab bring-up, flight testing and failure analysis. Before university I spent three seasons in FIRST Robotics, going from technician to Mechanical Lead.

items.desc: Lead hardware designer of IGNIS. Vice President of a 30-member team; lead the 9-member electronics area and train new members on flight-computer design and assembly.
Led manufacturing and served on the drive team; won the Hermosillo Regional and qualified for the FIRST World Championship in Houston (2024).

items.name: IGNIS Flight Computer
items.desc: Open-source rocket flight computer, v1 to v5. ESP32-S3, LoRa telemetry, GNSS, IMU, barometer and two opto-isolated pyro channels. v2.2 flew at LASC 2026 as the primary flight computer.

items.name: LASC 2026 CanSat
items.desc: Mission Leader. IGNIS-derived CanSat with vibration sensing, LoRa telemetry and independent parachute recovery.
